llm.summary: This interview-coaching skill is purpose-aligned and disclosed, but users should be aware it can read provided resumes and store local practice history.

dimensions.detail: The skill asks to read resume files only when the user provides them and does not instruct credential access, broad filesystem scanning, network exfiltration, or unsafe command execution.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The artifact is markdown-only, but README installation examples use an unpinned npx command, which is a supply-chain hygiene issue rather than evidence of malicious skill behavior.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Most instructions are scoped to interview coaching, though some trigger phrases such as history/progress wording are broad enough that hosts should route them carefully or confirm ambiguous requests.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: Local history persistence at ~/.ai-interview-coach/history.json is disclosed and aligned with progress tracking, but it may contain sensitive career and performance information and should have clearer consent, retention, and deletion guidance.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The capabilities match the stated interview-preparation purpose: resume or role analysis, question generation, mock interviews, scoring, answer rewriting, and progress tracking.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you are comfortable with an interview coach reading resumes you explicitly provide and keeping local practice history. Prefer redacting unnecessary personal details from resumes, check or delete ~/.ai-interview-coach/history.json when needed, and consider using a pinned/manual install path instead of the unpinned npx command.
llm.findings:
[AE1] expected: Downgraded: examples.md is present in the workspace and was inspected; it contains local usage examples, not hidden remote payloads or unavailable runtime instructions.
[RP1] unexpected: Accepted as installation guidance risk: README uses unpinned npx examples, but this is not intrinsic malicious behavior in the skill artifact.
[T08] unexpected: Accepted as the same unpinned installer concern from static scan; users should prefer pinned or manual installation when possible.
[SQP-2] expected: Resume processing and history use are expected for this skill; the concern is partially accepted because privacy, minimization, and retention details are under-documented.
[SQP-1] expected: Partially accepted: history, progress, and interview-practice triggers are related to the purpose, but some are generic and could benefit from confirmation before showing stored history or reading files.
[SSD-3] expected: Accepted as a user-awareness issue: the skill documents local auto-save of session records with scores and file paths, which is purpose-aligned but sensitive.
[SQP-3] expected: Downgraded for security adjudication: the artifacts are predominantly Chinese, which appears to be a locale choice rather than malicious or deceptive behavior.
